The '''A27 Division''' was a mobile [[Tank/Legends|armored]] [[Division/Legends|division]] in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The A27 Division utilized [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|STAPs]] and [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droids]].
